# TOST equivalence test

# Two one-sided t-tests:
# H01: μ_diff >= ε  →  t1 = (mean_diff - ε) / SE
# H02: μ_diff <= -ε →  t2 = (mean_diff + ε) / SE
mean_diff = np.mean(openvla_peak) - np.mean(phi3v_peak)
se = np.sqrt(np.var(openvla_peak)/len(openvla_peak) + np.var(phi3v_peak)/len(phi3v_peak))
t1 = (mean_diff - epsilon) / se
t2 = (mean_diff + epsilon) / se
df = len(openvla_peak) + len(phi3v_peak) - 2
p1 = stats.t.cdf(t1, df)  # should be small
p2 = 1 - stats.t.cdf(t2, df)  # should be small
p_tost = max(p1, p2)

# 90% CI for the difference
ci_90 = stats.t.interval(0.90, df, loc=mean_diff, scale=se)
